summary: Reviewed owner-approved structure simplification: one public launcher; internal deployment templates and nested skill manifest; current private command defaults; no YAML state runtime, alias, native-app setup fallback or wrappers. Native Codex supervision and owner-only service credentials remain supported. Real source export/staging, profile/skills discovery, SQLite/MCP/worker/gateway regressions and vault integrity pass locally; accounts, deployed services and remote publication are outside this change.
